However, the root 'N-M-R' is a beautiful one that embodies the joy and pleasure found in the acts of obedience to Allah. data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the pursuit of pleasure and happiness is closely linked to the obedience of Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Allah is pleased with His servant as long as he is pleased with it." (Bukhari and Muslim). The name "Namar" is a reminder of this concept, inviting us to seek pleasure and joy in following the commandments of Allah and living in accordance with His will. It is a name that inspires us to strive for happiness in this world while focusing on the permanent happiness that awaits us in the hereafter. May Allah grant us the understanding and the will to fulfill His commandments and find true happiness in our lives. Ameen.
